create_custom_formatter: create a CustomFormatter class that applies color-coded ANSI formatting to different log levels
get_default_logger: get a default logger with custom color formatting and a StreamHandler for a given logger name
get_parent_logger: get a parent logger that propagates logs to parent handlers without adding new handlers
format_log_record: format a log record using the CustomFormatter to apply level-specific ANSI color codes
configure_logger_handlers: configure a logger by removing existing handlers and adding a new StreamHandler with CustomFormatter
